title: Add sqlx/auth dependencies and initial migration
acceptance: api crate includes sqlx, uuid, time, argon2, async-trait
notes: Verify against spec before extending schema.

title: Add AppState and router state wiring
acceptance: Health test does not require a live DB connection
notes: Health uses a lazy pool because /healthz does not touch DB.

title: Review auth domain types and error mapping against spec
acceptance: ApiError status codes and JSON bodies match design spec
User, Role, ApiToken, and Scope match schema
notes: ScopeRequired now returns structured scope details; error mapping matches the Plan 2 spec review.

title: Review bearer auth extractor and scope guard
acceptance: last_used_at update behavior is intentional and documented
notes: Token parser handles underscores in secrets; unknown DB roles no longer silently map to user; implementation compiles without sqlx online macros.

title: Review idempotency middleware semantics
acceptance: Same key and same request returns stored response
Same key and different request returns 409
Middleware state wiring works with Axum 0.8
notes: Replay verifies the bearer token secret before returning stored responses; successful responses are persisted before returning.

title: Make SQL lint quiet and Postgres-specific
acceptance: make check emits no sqlfluff dialect warning
notes: .sqlfluff sets postgres dialect and current migration passes sqlfluff lint.

title: Decide DB integration test contract
acceptance: Docs clarify whether make check skips DB tests or requires make db-up
notes: make check skips DB-backed auth tests unless AME_RUN_DB_TESTS=1; make test-db is the explicit DB integration path after make db-up.
